design: Lean barrel-chested courier with a broad cheek ridge and short asymmetrical mandible tusks, most dreadlocks gathered into a lateral braid behind the left shoulder. Hinged flat octagonal dispatch case carried by its top handle at the right thigh, wraparound single-shoulder harness, layered short travel kilt and two tiny belt rolls. Standing with one knee softly bent and the left hand checking a buckle. Moss-grey scales.
